channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Keegan Murray | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Keegan Murray from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: De'Andre Hunter on Keegan Murray
item.description:
Hunter anticipates playing with Murray because their abilities to do some of the same things on the floor.

“Playing with a guy like Keegan, he's another versatile guy who can defend, who can shoot, who can score. I think it'll be fun,”

De'Andre Hunter on Keegan Murray, Feb 3, 2026. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Keegan Murray
item.description:
DeMar DeRozan on Keegan Murray injury:

“We feel for him more so than anything. Feel for Keegan because, you know, that's our brother, our teammate. We don't want to see nobody hurt. But with that, we still got a job to do. We can't hang our heads too long. And you can't always expect the NBA season to go perfect. Knock on wood, I hope this is all to come and, you know, he get back healthy and we can hold down the fort until then.”

DeMar DeRozan on Keegan Murray, Oct 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Doug Christie on Keegan Murray
item.description:
For first-year head coach Doug Christie, he understands all that Murray brings to the table, but he wants to see the 25-year-old be more aggressive.

“Part of things I talk to Keegan about is hunting shots. … Keegan has to learn that mentality and it’s a learned thing,”

Doug Christie on Keegan Murray, Oct 1, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Keegan Murray
item.description:
Jason Anderson:De'Aaron Fox on Keegan Murray:

“We already talk about him being one of the best 3-point shooters in the league, not just as a rookie, but out of everybody. We want him to just continue to grow and he knows that he has an entire group behind him.”

De'Aaron Fox on Keegan Murray, Mar 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Mike Brown on Keegan Murray
item.description:
Kings coach Mike Brown on keeping Keegan Murray as a starter even after struggles:

“He's our guy, and he's going to stay there. He's going to continue to learn on the job and get better, but he's been good for us as of late, and hopefully, he'll be like that for a while.”

Mike Brown on Keegan Murray, Dec 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Mike Brown on Keegan Murray
item.description:
Kings coachMike Brown on Keegan Murray:

“He’s a rookie and you know the ups and downs are going to come for him. You don’t know when they’re going to come. They may last two games or they may last 10 games, but at the end of the day, we’re going to stay with him. He’s our guy.”

Mike Brown on Keegan Murray, Nov 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Monte McNair on Keegan Murray
item.description:
“I think adding Keegan, somebody who he just said can play multiple positions, really helps us as we build it out,”

Monte McNair on Keegan Murray, Jun 27, 2022. Source: Kings Beat.
